sentences.en: A new shopping mall opened on the edge of town.
sentences.zh: 镇边新开了一家购物中心。

sentences.en: Several retailers left the mall due to increasingly unaffordable rent.
sentences.zh: 几家零售商因租金越来越贵而离开了购物中心。

sentences.en: I thought you were coming to the mall with us.
sentences.zh: 我还以为你会和我们一起逛购物中心呢。

senses.zh: 商场，购物广场；步行商业区；步行道；铁圈球球场
